test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At a health club, 56% of the members are women and 44% of the members are men. If the average age of the men is 35 years and the average age of the women is 30 years, what is the average age (in years) of all the members?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of women = 56%

Percentage of men = 44%

Average age of women = 30 years

Average age of men = 35 years

**Formula used:**

Weighted Average = (Percentage of Group 1 × Average of Group 1 + Percentage of Group 2 × Average of Group 2) / 100

**Calculation:**

Weighted Average = (56 × 30 + 44 × 35) / 100

⇒ Weighted Average = (1680 + 1540) / 100

⇒ Weighted Average = 3220 / 100 = 32.2

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
